in_marathi.name: Chanakya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chanakya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chanakya is a Sanskrit name derived from Chanakya Pandit, a renowned scholar and advisor to the ancient Indian emperor Chandragupta Maurya. The name Chanakya is often associated with wisdom, knowledge, and strategic intelligence. According to mythology, Chanakya's wisdom and guidance played a significant role in the rise and consolidation of the Mauryan Empire.
